forecast = a report that says what the weather will be
cloudy = with a lot of cloud and little sun
foggy = with thick cloud near the ground that is hard to see through
lightning = a flash of light in the sky during a storm
thunder = the loud noise that follows lightning
hail = frozen rain that falls as small balls of ice
drought = a long time with little or no rain
flood = water covering land that is usually dry
hurricane = a very strong tropical storm with fast winds
climate = the usual weather in a place over many years
environment = the air, water, land and living things around us
pollution = dirty air, water or land caused by people
recycle = to turn used materials into new products
rubbish = things you throw away
litter = rubbish left on the ground in a public place
endangered = at risk of disappearing as a species
extinct = no longer existing as a species
wildlife = animals and plants living in nature, not kept by people
habitat = the natural place where an animal or plant lives
rainforest = a thick, wet forest in a hot part of the world
